entries.reason: the class arrived in iOS 13 and 6.1.3 has no movie class. An AVAsset subclass that answers, from one AVURLAsset made from the same URL and options, every AVAsset member the 16.4 header declares on AVAsset and this release carries; its tracks are AVMovieTrack objects built once from that asset's tracks, and trackWithTrackID: and the filters search them. The read side of AVMovie only: the writer pair and AVMutableMovie are other rows. Behaviour is the design in facts/AVFoundation/AVMovie.md and is not yet measured against the host
entries.effect: a movie opened from a URL answers from the release's own AVURLAsset; a movie opened from data is written to a file in the temporary directory and read from there, and that file is removed at dealloc; -init makes a movie with no URL, no inner asset and no tracks; -copyWithZone: returns the movie itself retained; isEqual: and hash are the release's own, as for any AVAsset
entries.source: SDK 16.4 AVFoundation/AVMovie.h:57; AVAsset and AVAssetTrack of the 6.1.3 armv7 cache, read with objc-inventory

entries.reason: the class arrived in iOS 13 and 6.1.3 has no movie track class. An AVAssetTrack subclass that wraps one AVAssetTrack of the movie's asset and answers every AVAssetTrack member the 16.4 header declares and this release carries from that track; -asset is the movie that made it, held weakly. Its own members mediaPresentationTimeRange, mediaDecodeTimeRange, alternateGroupID and mediaDataStorage are not answered and have their own rows. Behaviour is the design in facts/AVFoundation/AVMovie.md and is not yet measured against the host
entries.effect: the track's values are the wrapped track's own; -asset answers the AVMovie that made the track, never the inner asset; the SDK marks -init unavailable (AVAssetTrack.h:40) and a track is made only by its movie, so a caller gets a track only from AVMovie's tracks
entries.source: SDK 16.4 AVFoundation/AVMovieTrack.h:33; AVAssetTrack of the 6.1.3 armv7 cache, read with objc-inventory
